# Huan Mao International Company Limited (環貿國際有限公司)

> ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified OEM/ODM manufacturer of melamine particleboard and MDF furniture in Hai Phong, Vietnam. Supplies U.S. furniture brands with classroom storage, office credenzas, consoles and ready-to-assemble (RTA) furniture.

- Established: 2024, Taiwanese management, about 100 employees
- Annual sales: about US$10 million
- Factory: Quan Goi Quarter, Thuong Khuong Hamlet, Ke Sat Commune, Hai Phong City, Vietnam
- Processes: CNC nesting, CNC boring, PVC edge banding, RTA packing with hardware kits
- Contact: sales@huanmaofurniture.com, +84 369 686 820
